title: The genus-three formula conjecture for the coefficients $S_{n,k}^{(3)}$
statement: Let $S_{n,k}^{(g)}$ denote the coefficients indexed by $n$, $k$, and genus $g$, and let the expression referred to as $$ be the proposed formula for these coefficients. **Genus-three formula conjecture.** The expression $$, with $g=3$, gives $S_{n,k}^{(3)}$ for all $n$ and $k$. The formula agrees with all presently known experimental values and its sum over $k$ agrees with $B_n^{(3)}$; its validity beyond the tested range remains open.
source_name: Robert Coquereaux and Jean-Bernard Zuber, “Counting partitions by genus: a compendium of results”, arXiv:2305.01100 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.01100

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2023).
